capabilities: Run read-only SQL queries against local SQLite databases from sql or sqlite code blocks
Render query results as tables with a footer showing filename, retrieval time, and row count
Cache results inside the code block as fallback for mobile or unavailable databases
Control refresh behavior with REFRESH directives, including timed auto-refresh
disambiguation: Not a one-way converter or exporter; it renders live query results inside notes rather than turning database files into Markdown files.
extras: Manifest carries an unreviewed-plugin disclaimer. Live queries work on desktop only; mobile shows cached results. Full design details are in a separate ARCHITECTURE.md, not the README.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to query a local SQLite database and display the results inside a note.

relations.evidence: Uses sql.js v1.14+ — SQLite compiled to WebAssembly via Emscripten.

summary: Runs read-only SQLite queries from fenced code blocks and renders the results as tables in reading view.
